description:
Site: crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/principal.rs:36 and :303 reference [`BackendChangesError::CannotCalculate`] in rustdoc without a path qualifier. The type lives in `jmap_server::backend` (re-exported as `jmap_server::BackendChangesError`) but principal.rs does not bring it into scope, so the intra-doc link fails to resolve.

This is a pre-existing breakage that has been in the workspace since before bd:JMAP-ayoz.41.1 (per the bd-prime kb note). Running `RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-sharing-server --no-deps` fails with:

    error: unresolved link to `BackendChangesError::CannotCalculate`
       --> crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/principal.rs:36 (and :303)

Workspace `cargo doc --workspace` fails on these. Other workspace crates do not have analogous issues.

Fix: either (a) qualify the link to `[`jmap_server::BackendChangesError::CannotCalculate`]`, or (b) bring `BackendChangesError` into scope via `use jmap_server::BackendChangesError;` at the top of principal.rs.

Discovered while running rustdoc gate for bd:JMAP-x2gd.48 (register_account doc-hidden sweep).
title: jmap-sharing-server: pre-existing broken intra-doc links to BackendChangesError::CannotCalculate
